text:
The upstream Gemini credential is rejected (400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, 'Please pass a valid API key'), so article generation and catalogue search fail on every request. The owner decided not to restore the key: the project is retired and only the Sentry noise had to stop. So the site is expected to serve the degraded 'archives briefly suspended' pages indefinitely, and that is not a bug to chase.

Two richer options were offered and declined in favour of the four-line log-level change: (a) classifying credential rejection as ImproperlyConfigured behind a single chat-completion helper, and (b) a cache-throttled ERROR every 15 minutes to keep alerting alive. Both were rejected for speed, accepting that model failures now produce no Sentry events at all. Revisit (b) first if the project is ever revived.

Vendor quirk worth remembering if (a) is ever built: Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns HTTP 400 for a bad API key, not 401, so status alone cannot identify a credential problem.
